description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and constants for managing Type 42 font objects in the FreeType project.

classes.name: T42_SizeRec
classes.description: Structure representing a Type 42 size object, containing a root FT_SizeRec and a ttsize.

classes.name: T42_GlyphSlotRec
classes.description: Structure representing a Type 42 glyph slot, containing a root FT_GlyphSlotRec and a ttslot.

classes.name: T42_DriverRec
classes.description: Structure representing a Type 42 driver, containing a root FT_DriverRec and a ttclazz.

methods.name: T42_Face_Init
methods.description: Initializes a Type 42 face object from a stream and face index.

methods.name: T42_Face_Done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with a Type 42 face object.

methods.name: T42_Size_Request
methods.description: Handles size request for a Type 42 font.

methods.name: T42_Size_Select
methods.description: Selects a specific size or strike in a Type 42 font.

methods.name: T42_GlyphSlot_Init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph slot for Type 42.

methods.name: T42_GlyphSlot_Load
methods.description: Loads a glyph into a glyph slot for Type 42.

methods.name: T42_GlyphSlot_Done
methods.description: Finalizes a glyph slot for Type 42.
